extracted.name: Bean Soup with Kale
extracted.description: This white bean and kale soup is simple to make with creamy cannellini beans in a rich tomato and garlic broth for a nourishing homemade meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon olive oil or canola oil
8 large garlic cloves, crushed or minced
4 cups low-fat, low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
2 (15 ounce) cans white beans, such as cannellini or navy, undrained
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook and stir onion and garlic in hot oil until soft.
Add kale; cook and stir until wilted.
Add 3 cups broth, 2 cups beans, tomatoes, herb seasoning, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix remaining beans and broth in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Stir into soup to thicken, then simmer for 15 minutes. Ladle into bowls; sprinkle with parsley to serve.
